Rowe Price, said in a commentary this week.”.

On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “Global stocks were mixed and European shares edged higher on Friday after a global bond sell-off deepened and ahead of a U.S. monthly jobs report due later in the day.”; on the same day, The Wall Street Journal reported “Stock futures edged higher and Treasury yields steadied in early European trade, as market sentiment lifts at the beginning of jobs day.”.
